title: Sign in
caption: Type your username and password and press Sign in. On a new computer or phone the owner signs in with username Admin and password 1234. Leave "Keep me signed in" ticked on the shop computer. Change the 1234 password straight away (step 3).

title: Home
caption: The first screen every day: sales, cash received and expenses today, the everyday buttons, anything that needs attention (unpaid bills, old debts, batches about to expire, low stock) and the latest bills.

title: Change your password
caption: Click your name at the top right, then My account & password. Type the current password (1234 the first time) and a new one of at least 8 characters, twice, and press Change password.

title: Your shop details
caption: Admin → System & Backups. The company name, tagline, address, phone and email here are printed on every bill, receipt and report.

title: Bill settings
caption: Same page, the Bills & stock card. Choose the paper: A4, A5 or 80 mm thermal receipt. Type a footer for every bill, tick "Show previous balance on bill" if customers should see their old balance, and decide whether a bill may go through when stock is short.

title: Staff accounts
caption: Admin → User Accounts & Auth. Every person has their own username and password, so the app knows who made each bill. Here Rashid is a manager and Zahid works the counter as an operator.

title: Add a staff member
caption: Press Add staff. Full name, a username, the role (the counter role is called Weighbridge Operator in this list) and a temporary password. Give them the password; the first time they sign in they must choose their own.

title: What each role may do
caption: Admin → Roles & RBAC Matrix. Each tick is something a role may do. The built-in roles suit most shops: Operator for the counter, Operations Manager for a trusted manager, Administrator for the owner. The table "Who can do what" at the end of this guide sums it up.

title: Bill and document numbers
caption: Admin → Rules, numbers & branches → Document numbers. Pick the prefix for bills, credit notes, quotations, receipts and orders. Tick "New series each year" to start again every year (RZT-2026-0001). Numbers never repeat, even after a delete.

title: The price list
caption: Items & Prices: every item with its code, group, brand, pack, selling price, stock and stock value. Red LOW means stock is at or below the re-order level. Filter by group or brand, or search by name, code or barcode. (Here the side menu is folded with the arrow at its bottom, to give the list more room.)

title: Add an item
caption: New item: name, sold per (tin, can, pouch…), selling price and cost price. A pack such as "carton = 4 cans" lets you bill and receive in cartons. Add the group, brand, barcode (or press Make one), a photo, and the re-order level. Tick "Track batch & expiry" for goods with an expiry date.

title: Receive a delivery
caption: Receive stock: pick the supplier, then each item with its quantity and cost. Add another item for the next line of the same delivery. The total is added to what you owe that supplier.

title: Receive a batch with an expiry date
caption: For a batch-tracked item the form also asks for the batch number and expiry date.

title: Batches on the price list
caption: Each batch is listed under its item with its expiry date and quantity. Amber means it expires within 30 days, red means expired. Bills always take the batch that expires first and never sell expired stock.

title: Godowns
caption: If you keep stock in more than one place, press Godowns and add each one. The main godown is always there.

title: Move stock between godowns
caption: Move stock between godowns: the item, from, to, and how many. The total stock does not change.

title: Stock in each godown
caption: With two godowns, each item shows how much is in each place. A bill can pick which godown the goods leave from.

title: Adjust stock with a reason
caption: Adjust stock for a leak, damage, expiry or a count correction. Pick the reason, the quantity and a note. The loss at cost goes to Stock losses in the accounts. A big loss may need a manager's approval.

title: Item history
caption: Click an item's name to see every movement: received, sold on which bill, returned, adjusted or moved, with the balance after each.

title: Re-order report
caption: Re-order lists what is at or below its re-order level, with the usual supplier, quantity and last rate. Tick what to buy and press Make purchase order: one order is made for each supplier.

title: Barcode labels
caption: Press Labels, type how many labels you want for each item and press Preview labels. You get an A4 sheet with the shop name, item, barcode and price. Print it at 100% on label paper. A barcode scanner on New Bill then finds the item.

title: Customers
caption: Every customer with their Customer ID, credit limit and balance. The bar shows how much of the limit is used; it turns amber near the limit (Haji Karim is at 82%). Receive and New bill work straight from the row.

title: Add a customer
caption: Add customer: an optional Customer ID (C-107), name, phone and address. A credit limit is optional: leave it empty for no limit. With a limit, a bill that would take them over it is stopped.

title: One customer
caption: Click a customer: what they owe, their bills, money received and how much of the limit is used. The buttons make a new bill, take a payment, make a quotation or print a statement.

title: Special rates for a customer
caption: Special rates for this customer: pick an item and their rate, press Save rate. Their bills then use that rate automatically, marked CUSTOMER RATE.

title: Sales & recovery
caption: Customers → Sales & recovery holds the salesmen and areas, schemes, sales reports, recovery list, collections, commission and late-payment interest.

title: Salesmen
caption: Salesmen & areas: add each salesman with their phone and commission %.

title: Areas and routes
caption: The Areas / routes tab lists the areas you sell into. On each customer (step above) pick their area and salesman; new bills fill them in by themselves.

title: Open a new bill (F2)
caption: Press New Bill, or F2 from any screen. Keyboard: type to find a customer or item, Enter moves to the next box, + adds a line, Ctrl+Enter or F9 saves. F3 opens Receive payment, F4 Add expense, F6 Receive stock.

title: Pick the customer
caption: Pick the customer by name, phone or Customer ID. The box under it shows their balance, credit left, last payment and last bills, so you know before you sell.

title: Sell in cartons or single cans
caption: Pick the item. For items with a pack, press carton to type cartons; the price becomes the carton price. The line shows the stock, the last rate for this customer, the customer's special rate and the batch that will be used.

title: Free goods from a scheme
caption: With a scheme such as "buy 10 tins, get 1 free", the free tins are added by themselves in the green box at price 0. The bin removes them if needed.

title: Discount on one line
caption: Press Discount under a line and type Rs. or %. A discount on the whole bill goes in the Discount box further down.

title: Salesman and area
caption: The customer's salesman and area fill in by themselves. Change them for this bill if someone else made the sale.

title: Freight and loading
caption: Type any cartage or loading you charge the customer. It is added to the total and shown on the bill.

title: Split payment: cash + bank + cheque
caption: Normally type Paid now (Full fills the whole amount) and pick the method. If the customer pays in more than one way, press Split: cash + bank + cheque and type each part. For a cheque add its number, bank and date. Whatever is not paid stays on their account.

title: Save & Print (A4)
caption: Save & Print opens the bill: your details, the customer and Customer ID, salesman and area, each line with cartons, batch, discount and free goods, freight, what was paid and the balance, and your footer. Print it or save it as PDF to send on WhatsApp.

title: Thermal receipt
caption: With 80 mm thermal paper chosen in Bill settings, the same bill prints as a narrow receipt for a counter printer.

title: Bills
caption: Bills: every bill, newest first. Today, 7 days, This month or All; search by number, customer, phone or item. Amber amounts are still due.

title: Unpaid bills
caption: Press Unpaid to see only bills with money still due.

title: Open a bill
caption: Click a bill: its lines, total, paid and balance, what the customer owes on all bills, and the buttons to print, send on WhatsApp, make a delivery challan or take back items.

title: Take a payment later
caption: In Receive payment type the amount, pick the method and press Receive. The balance drops and the payment is listed. Cash goes to the drawer, bank transfers and wallets to the bank.

title: Return items
caption: Return items: type how many came back on each line and why. If nothing was paid it comes off what they owe; if they paid, you can give the money back. The stock goes back in.

title: Credit note
caption: Saving prints a credit note (CN-1) for the customer, linked to the bill.

title: Delivery challan
caption: Delivery challan on the bill: add the driver and vehicle number and press Print challan.

title: The printed challan
caption: Items and quantities only, no prices, with lines for the driver and the person who receives the goods.

title: Make a quotation
caption: Bills → Quotations → New Quotation. Pick the customer, items, quantities and your offered price, then Save & Print.

title: Quotation to bill
caption: The quotation is listed as Not sent. When the customer agrees, press Make bill.

title: The bill from the quotation
caption: A new bill opens with the quotation's customer, items and prices. Check it and press Save. The quotation is marked Billed.

title: Approval rules
caption: Admin → Rules, numbers & branches. Set the limits: a discount above 10%, a supplier payment above Rs. 200,000, a stock loss above Rs. 20,000. Anyone who is not a manager must send these for approval. Leave a box empty to switch that rule off.

title: A bill that needs approval
caption: Zahid (operator) gives a 15% discount. The bill says "Needs a manager's approval" and he can write a note for the manager.

title: Sent for approval
caption: Saving sends it to Approvals. Nothing goes to the stock or the books until a manager approves it.

title: Waiting on Home
caption: When a manager signs in, Home shows what is waiting for approval.

title: Approve or reject
caption: The Approvals list shows who asked, why, and the full bill. Approve posts it; Reject needs a note and posts nothing.

title: Approved
caption: Once approved, the bill gets its number and is posted like any other bill. Done lists everything decided, with who decided.

title: Where the money is
caption: Money: cash in hand, bank, what customers owe you and what you owe. "Money in the business" adds it up. Opening balances holds the cash and bank you started with.

title: Add an expense (F4)
caption: Add expense: what for, the amount, the category and where it was paid from (cash, bank or on credit).

title: Expense sheets
caption: Money → Expense sheets: each category is its own sheet for the month, with every entry and its total.

title: Cash ↔ Bank
caption: Deposit cash into the bank or take cash out. The buttons show what is in the drawer and in the bank; you can't move more than you have.

title: Receive from many
caption: When the recovery man comes back: Money → Receive from many. Tick each customer who paid and type the amount and method. One save records them all.

title: Collection sheet
caption: It prints one collection sheet with every customer and amount.

title: Cheques due
caption: Home shows the cheques due this week, coming in and going out. Click it to open the cheque register.

title: Receive a cheque
caption: Money → Cheques → Cheque received: the customer, amount, cheque number, bank and the date on the cheque. A post-dated cheque is kept "in hand" until its date. The customer's balance goes down at once.

title: The cheque register
caption: Every cheque by stage: In hand, Due this week, Deposited, Bounced, Issued (given to suppliers). The tiles show the totals.

title: Deposit a cheque
caption: On its date press Deposit on the cheque and confirm.

title: Cheque cleared
caption: When the bank credits it, press Mark cleared on the Deposited tab. Only then is the money added to the bank.

title: Cheque bounced
caption: If it bounces press Bounced: write why, the bank's charge and who pays it. A manager does this.

title: After a bounce
caption: The amount (and the charge, if the customer pays it) goes back on the customer's account, and the cheque moves to the Bounced tab.

title: The daily sheet
caption: Daily Sheet: the whole day on one page. Opening and closing cash and bank, every bill, all money received, expenses by sheet, supplier payments, deposits and cheques. Use the arrows to look at another day.

title: Print the daily sheet
caption: Print it at closing time, with Prepared by and Checked by lines.

title: Check the bank statement
caption: Money → Bank reconciliation → Upload statement (CSV) from your bank. The columns are guessed; check them and press Import.

title: Matched automatically
caption: Each statement line is paired with the same amount in your books, within 3 days. Lines not in your books are marked in amber.

title: Add what is missing
caption: For a bank charge press Add as expense; for a customer's transfer, record it against the customer. It is then matched.

title: Reconciled ✓
caption: Type the closing balance from the statement. When books and bank agree it shows Reconciled ✓. Entries in your books that the bank has not shown yet are listed underneath; tick each one when it appears on a statement (Tick all as cleared does them all).

title: Reconciliation report
caption: Save it, and print the reconciliation for your records or your accountant.

title: Suppliers
caption: Every supplier with their Supplier ID (S-104 Dalda Foods, S-105 Tajj Mill…) and what you owe. Pay and Receive stock work from the row.

title: Purchase order
caption: Suppliers → Orders → New order: the supplier, items, quantities and agreed rates. Save and print it for the supplier.

title: The order
caption: The order shows what was ordered, received and billed for each line. Press Receive goods when the truck arrives.

title: Receive against the order
caption: The quantities and rates come from the order. Change the quantity if less arrived (28 of 30 tins here).

title: Orders list
caption: The order is now Partly received and Waiting for bill.

title: Supplier bill (three-way match)
caption: Supplier bills → Record supplier bill. Tick the goods received, type the supplier's bill number, quantity and rate. The app checks order, goods received and bill against each other: here the rate is higher, so the Rs. difference is added to what you owe and marked Mismatch.

title: Supplier claim
caption: Claims → New claim for leaked, damaged or short goods: the supplier, the delivery and the quantity.

title: Claims list
caption: The claim waits until the supplier answers. Press Accepted (the amount comes off what you owe) or Rejected.

title: Return goods to a supplier
caption: Return goods: the supplier, item, quantity, rate and reason. Press Send back.

title: Debit note
caption: A debit note prints for the supplier. The stock goes out and what you owe comes down.

title: Purchase register
caption: Suppliers → Stock received: every delivery and return for the dates, supplier or item you pick, with the net total. CSV and Print are at the top.

title: Pay a supplier
caption: Pay on a supplier: the amount and method. It shows the balance before and after. A payment over the approval limit made by staff waits for a manager.

title: Cheque layout
caption: To print on your own cheque book: Money → Cheques → Cheque layout. Set where the date, name, amount in words and figures go on your bank's leaf (in mm). Set once.

title: Print a cheque
caption: Print cheque on a cheque you gave a supplier: the name, date, amount in figures and in words (Rupees One Lakh Twenty-Five Thousand Only) land in the right places.

title: Who owes for how long
caption: Customers → Who owes for how long: each customer's money split into 0–30, 31–60, 61–90 and over 90 days. Old Khan Store's bill is over 60 days old. Switch to "You owe suppliers" for the other side.

title: Recovery list by area
caption: Sales & recovery → Recovery list, By area: who owes money in each area, oldest bill first.

title: Recovery sheet for the recovery man
caption: Print it for the recovery man, with a column to write what he received.

title: Sales by salesman
caption: Sales by salesman / area: bills, sales, returns and freight for each salesman, for any dates.

title: Sales by area
caption: Press By area for the same figures by area.

title: Commission
caption: Commission: what each salesman earned at their %, what is paid, and what is still owed. Pay commission records it as an expense.

title: Profit by item
caption: Accounts → Profit by item: sales, cost and profit on each item for your dates, with the margin.

title: Profit by customer
caption: By customer: which customers bring the most profit.

title: Profit by group and brand
caption: By group and By brand add up the items, so you can see whether Dalda, Tajj or Habib earns you more.

title: Owner dashboard
caption: Owner dashboard: sales and gross profit today and this month, cash, bank, who owes you and who you owe, stock value, cheques due, old debts, a 30-day sales chart and the top customers and items.

title: Daily business report
caption: Daily business report prints the day's figures on one page for the owner.

title: Export to Excel (CSV)
caption: Every list and report has a CSV button. The file opens in Excel or Google Sheets.

title: Trial balance
caption: Accounts is for the owner and the accountant. Every bill, payment, expense, cheque and delivery is posted here by itself. The trial balance shows every account; Balanced ✓ means debits equal credits.

title: Ledger
caption: Click an account to see every entry with a running balance, like a bank statement. Bill numbers open the bill.

title: Journal
caption: Journal: every entry, automatic and manual, newest first.

title: Manual journal entry
caption: New journal entry for corrections and owner's money: a narration and the accounts. It only saves when debits equal credits (Balanced ✓).

title: Chart of accounts
caption: The accounts money is sorted into, set up for a Pakistani trading shop. Add your own, such as a second bank.

title: Profit & Loss
caption: Sales, less the cost of what was sold, less expenses, for a financial year or any dates. Did the business make money?

title: Balance sheet
caption: What the business owns against what it owes and what belongs to the owner, on one date. Balanced ✓.

title: Cash flow & ratios
caption: Where the cash came from and went, and a few health numbers such as the current ratio and gross margin.

title: Budget vs actual
caption: Budgets: set a monthly figure for each expense (Set budget), then Budget vs actual shows how much is used. Green is on track, amber close, red over.

title: Cost centres
caption: Cost centres: profit and loss by branch, area or vehicle. Tag an expense with the Shehzore truck and see what the truck costs.

title: Add a fixed asset
caption: Fixed assets → Add asset for things the shop keeps for years: the name, type, cost, date and useful life. It shows the monthly depreciation.

title: Depreciation
caption: Run for the month books the depreciation. It is never charged twice. Print register gives the asset list with book values.

title: Staff
caption: Staff & salaries: each person, their job and monthly salary, and any advance they owe.

title: Salary sheet
caption: Salary sheet for the month: salary, advances taken back, bonus or deduction, and net pay. Pay salaries books it all at once.

title: Payslip
caption: A payslip for each person, with the net pay in words.

title: Year end
caption: Year end: the financial year starts on 1 July. When the accountant has finished a year, check the list and press Close. The profit moves to the owner's side and that year is locked.

title: Close the year
caption: The app asks once more before closing. An admin can reopen the last closed year if a correction is needed.

title: Audit trail
caption: Admin → Audit Trail: who did what and when. Sign-ins, bills, payments, deletes with their reason, and setting changes.

title: Delete with a reason
caption: Deleting always asks why. The reason is kept.

title: Deleted records
caption: Admin → Deleted records keeps a copy of everything deleted, with who, when and why.

title: Put it back
caption: Press Restore and the customer is back, as it was. Customers, suppliers, items, expenses and cash entries can be put back.

title: Backups
caption: Admin → System & Backups. A backup is made on this device every day the app is open; the last 14 are kept. Press Back up now any time, and Download backup now and then to keep a copy somewhere safe (a USB or your email).

title: Branches
caption: Rules, numbers & branches → Branches, for shops with more than one outlet. Add each branch and pick where each person works. Home, Bills, Daily sheet, Money and Accounts then get a branch filter.

title: The full trading suite
caption: Full trading suite at the bottom of the side menu opens the bigger screens: bookings, truck dispatches, fleet, stock flow. Back to simple billing brings the simple screens back.
